description: Microdrives containing 4 tetrodes were built by threading 90% platinum, 10% iridium tetrode wires (18 µm HML-coated, Neuralynx) to an EIB-16 board (Neuralynx) via an inner cannula (21 gauge 9 mm long). The board was covered in epoxy and a poor lady frame (Axona) cemented to the side. An outer cannula (17 gauge 7 mm), placed around the inner cannula, was secured temporarily using vaseline, allowing it to be lowered during the surgery. Tetrodes were trimmed to ~3 mm using ceramic scissors (Science Tools, Germany) and gold plated (Non-cyanide gold plating solution, Neuralynx) to give an impedance between 150 and 200 kΩ at 1kHz.
